description: This source file contains performance tests and benchmarks for the Chromium project's cookie management system, including parsing cookies, adding cookies to a CookieMonster, querying, importing, and garbage collection timing.

classes.name: CookieMonsterTest
classes.description: Test fixture for cookie performance tests, setting up a single-threaded environment.

classes.name: CookieTestCallback
classes.description: Base class for cookie operation callbacks, providing synchronization for test completion.

classes.name: SetCookieCallback
classes.description: Callback class for setting cookies asynchronously.

classes.name: GetCookieListCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving cookie lists asynchronously.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies asynchronously.

methods.name: SetUpParseReporter
methods.description: Initializes a performance reporter for cookie parsing benchmarks.

methods.name: SetUpCookieMonsterReporter
methods.description: Initializes a performance reporter for CookieMonster operations.

methods.name: TestParseCookies
methods.description: Performance test for parsing standard cookies.

methods.name: TestParseBigCookies
methods.description: Performance test for parsing large cookies.

methods.name: TestAddCookiesOnSingleHost
methods.description: Performance test for adding, querying, and deleting cookies on a single host.

methods.name: TestAddCookieOnManyHosts
methods.description: Performance test for adding, querying, and deleting cookies across multiple hosts.

methods.name: TestDomainTree
methods.description: Performance test for setting cookies on a domain tree and querying them.

methods.name: TestDomainLine
methods.description: Performance test for setting cookies on a line of domains and querying them.

methods.name: TestImport
methods.description: Performance test for importing cookies from a large backing store.

methods.name: TestGetKey
methods.description: Performance test for retrieving cookie keys.

methods.name: TestGCTimes
methods.description: Performance test for garbage collection timing under various cookie store conditions.
